title: The Big Room Challenge
description: A fast, room-friendly challenge spanning geography, science, inventions, and world culture.

questions.question_text: What is the capital of Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Addis Ababa is Ethiopia’s capital and the seat of the African Union.
The Pacific is Earth’s largest and deepest ocean.

questions.question_text: Which element has the chemical symbol Au?
questions.explanation: Au comes from the Latin word for gold, aurum.
Vincent van Gogh painted it in 1889.

questions.question_text: Which invention is associated with Johannes Gutenberg?
questions.explanation: Gutenberg developed movable-type printing in Europe.

questions.question_text: What is the hardest natural substance?
questions.explanation: Diamond ranks highest on the Mohs hardness scale.

questions.question_text: Which country is home to Machu Picchu?
questions.explanation: The Inca citadel stands high in the Andes of Peru.

questions.question_text: How many strings does a standard violin have?
questions.explanation: A standard violin has four strings: G, D, A, and E.

questions.question_text: Which gas do plants absorb during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants use carbon dioxide, water, and light to make sugars.

questions.question_text: Which language has the most native speakers worldwide?
questions.explanation: Mandarin Chinese has the largest native-speaker population.
